/*selectSellerMpStRecmndOrderReceiptList*/
SELECT ROWNUM NUM , X.WMS_NAME /* 물류센타명 */ , X.VPO_NO /* 권고발주번호 */ , X.ITEM_AMT /* 금액 */ , X.ITEM_CNT /* 품목수 */ , X.RD_DATE /* 입고요청일 */ , X.VPO_DATE /* 발주일 */ , X.VPO_REMARK /* 비고 */ , X.BUYER /* 고객사 */ , X.DELY_TO_LOCATION /* 도착지 */ , X.AGENT FROM ( SELECT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER)) AS WMS_NAME , VPO_NO AS VPO_NO , SUM(A.ITEM_AMT) AS ITEM_AMT , COUNT(A.VPO_SEQ) AS ITEM_CNT , MAX(A.RD_DATE) AS RD_DATE , MAX(A.VPO_DATE) AS VPO_DATE , MAX(A.VPO_REMARK) AS VPO_REMARK , A.BUYER AS BUYER , MAX((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND TYPE = 'C012' AND CODE = A.DELY_TO_LOCATION)) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , MAX(A.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_CODE , MAX(A.AGENT) AS AGENT FROM EDIVPODT A WHERE A.RECV_FLAG = 'A' AND A.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND A.STATUS <> 'D' GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.VPO_NO ORDER BY 1,2 ) X
